Question: Alice needs to replace a light bulb located \(10\) centimeters below the ceiling in her kitchen. The ceiling is \(2.4\) meters above the floor. Alice is \(1.5\) meters tall and can reach \(46\) centimeters above the top of her head. Standing on a stool, she can just reach the light bulb. What is the height of the stool, in centimeters?
Solution:
Express all heights in centimeters, using \(1\) meter \(=100\) centimeters. The ceiling is 240 cm high, so the bulb is
\[
240-10=230\text{ cm}
\]
above the floor. Alice is 150 cm tall and reaches another 46 cm above her head, giving a floor-standing reach of
\[
150+46=196\text{ cm}.
\]
The stool raises her reach by its own height. Since she can just reach the bulb, that height is
\[
230-196=\boxed{34\text{ cm}},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
